_note: Shared fixture set for the WASM<->native parity harness. The native binary (src/bin/ezekiel1-parity.rs) and the WASM module (via parity.mjs) both run EVERY case below and their outputs must be byte-identical. Policies are referenced by key from `policies` to avoid duplication. `expect` is a human-readable assertion the native test also checks; parity itself is wasm-output == native-output.

policies.biz:
edition = "business"

[[tenants]]
name = "acme"

[[layers]]
name  = "root"
level = 3

[[layers]]
name   = "internal"
parent = "root"
level  = 2

[[subjects]]
name = "alice"
tenant = "acme"
assignments = [{ context = "default", layer = "root" }]

[[resources]]
id     = "acme/ledger"
layer  = "internal"
tenant = "acme"

[[grants]]
subject  = "alice"
resource = "acme/ledger"
action   = "read"
expires  = "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z"
